summary.text: Jack McFarland is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 13, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Bienville, Jackson, Natchitoches, and Winn parishes. First elected in 2015, Jack McFarland chairs the Appropriations Committee and serves as vice chair of the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jack McFarland's occupation as president of McFarland Timber, with a B.S. in business administration and industrial management from the University of Arkansas at Monticello and a diploma from Winnfield Senior High School.

The House page lists Jack McFarland's committee assignments as Appropriations (chair), Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget (vice chair), House Executive Committee, Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, Legislative Budgetary Control Council, and State Bond Commission, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
